evidence: Two independent regressions (0.55x): starting from the nightly config, slowdown vanished when changing driver to 550/560, precision to bf16/fp16, or tp to 1/2, but persisted across models (llama31, qwen25), GPUs (h100, rtx5090), chunked_prefill and tp 4/8; separately MI210 on driver 550 regressed at tp=8 with chunked_prefill=1 but was normal with chunked_prefill=0 or tp=1, independent of driver.
